stories.title: Accept a CSV upload and store it
stories.description: Add an upload endpoint that accepts a CSV file and saves its rows.
acceptance: Uploading a valid CSV under 10 MB returns success
The rows appear in the database afterwards

stories.title: Reject invalid CSV uploads
stories.description: Files over 10 MB or with wrong columns are rejected with a clear error and nothing is saved.
acceptance: A file over 10 MB returns an error message
A file with missing columns returns an error naming the missing columns
Nothing is saved when an error is returned
